content_html:
Many travelers dream of visiting Machu Picchu… but those who return to Peru discover something important:
Machu Picchu is only the beginning.

Peru is one of the most diverse countries in South America, with deserts, Amazon rainforest, mountains, beaches, and colonial cities that make a second trip potentially even more incredible than the first.

If you’ve already visited Machu Picchu—or want to explore more of the country during the same trip—here are the best destinations to discover Peru beyond Machu Picchu.

1. Qelccaya Glacier

Qelccaya Glacier Tour

Ideal for lovers of extreme nature and unique landscapes

The Qelccaya Glacier is the largest tropical ice mass in the world.

This experience offers:

  • Unique glacial landscapes in South America
  • High-altitude trekking
  • Extreme nature
  • An ideal route for adventurous travelers

Good physical condition and acclimatization required.

2. Sacred Valley of the Incas

Sacred Valley Tour

Ideal for cultural travelers and history lovers

The Sacred Valley is one of the most complete travel circuits in southern Peru.

Includes:

  • Pisac
  • Ollantaytambo

Perfect for travelers who want to dive deeper into Inca history beyond Machu Picchu.

3. Rainbow Mountain

Rainbow Mountain Tour

Ideal for adventure travelers

One of the most sought-after tours in Peru after Machu Picchu.

Includes:

  • High-altitude trekking
  • Unique Andean landscapes
  • Spectacular photography opportunities

Recommended for acclimatized travelers.

4. Humantay Lake

Humantay Lake Tour

Ideal for 1-day nature escapes

Humantay Lake is one of the most impressive short hikes near Cusco.

Highlights:

  • Intense turquoise water
  • Snow-capped mountains
  • Accessible route for moderate hikers

5. Waqrapukara

Waqrapukara Tour

Ideal for travelers seeking archaeology and off-the-beaten-path adventure

Waqrapukara is one of the most impressive emerging destinations near Cusco.

This archaeological complex combines:

  • Lesser-known Inca history
  • Spectacular mountain scenery
  • Adventure hiking
  • Much fewer crowds than more famous sites

Perfect for travelers seeking an authentic and different experience.

6. Lima + Paracas + Huacachina Route

Ideal for combining culture and adventure

One of the best extensions for international travelers.

Includes:

  • Gastronomic Lima
  • Ballestas Islands
  • Huacachina Oasis
  • Buggies and sandboarding

7. Arequipa + Colca Canyon

Ideal for travelers seeking landscapes and culture

One of the most impressive regions in Peru.

Includes:

  • The White City of Arequipa
  • Cruz del Cóndor Viewpoint
  • Colca Canyon

8. Peruvian Amazon

Ideal for nature and wildlife lovers

Explore the jungle from:

  • Puerto Maldonado
  • Iquitos

Featured experiences:

  • Jungle lodges
  • Wildlife observation
  • Amazon river navigation

How to Choose Your Ideal Second Trip in Peru?

It depends on your travel style:

  • Culture & History → Sacred Valley / South Valley / Historic Cusco
  • Adventure → Rainbow Mountain / Humantay
  • Nature → Amazon / Colca
  • Fun & Scenic Landscapes → Huacachina / Paracas

Peru has a perfect route for every traveler.

Why Return to Peru?

Because one trip is not enough.

Peru offers much more than Machu Picchu:

  • Living culture
  • Extreme nature
  • World-class gastronomy
  • Adventure for every level

Many travelers return because they know there is still so much left to discover.
